results.title: What is Trump's approval rating today? What polls say now

results.content:
In the latest Economist/YouGov survey, Trump is exiting August with a 33 percent approval rating, a new low for him in that poll.

Trump’s polling in the Decision Desk HQ (DDHQ) average did see a slight increase Thursday, reaching 39.2 percent.

Still, this average marked the second-lowest released by DDHQ since May, when Trump averaged 38 percent. The polling average also found that 57.5 percent disapproved of the president. [...] Trump’s numbers heading into the 2026 midterm elections are lower than they were at the same point in his term in 2018, when they typically stood around 40 percent. They reached their highest point at the start of the pandemic, at 49 percent in April and May 2020,
